references.text: The ash from the sin offering cow is used together with running water for cleansing, as described here
Describes the process of the red heifer being burned to make the ash mentioned in verse 9
Cleansing water (מֵי נִדָּה) is used for purification from impurity, the same expression as in verse 9
The Letter to the Hebrews refers to the ash from the heifer that cleanses the flesh and points to Christ's blood that cleanses the conscience
Similar to the instruction to place the ash in a clean place outside the camp
Ash from the offering fire is carried to a clean place outside the camp, parallel to the storage of the heifer's ash
Unclean persons are sent outside the camp, showing the importance of purity within the camp
